scenes.title: 문 앞의 대상과 계단 위의 대상
lines: The player aims at a target by the pink door. The next stairway shot turns the view upward. Follow the target’s height and the change in direction together.

scenes.title: 문을 차기와 방 안에서 겨누기
lines: The player kicks a door, then aims in another room. Facing a target can lead to different actions. Examine how the new kick connects to establishing a direction.

scenes.title: 지상 이동과 공중 우산
lines: Compare firing at the market with opening the umbrella near a wire in a separate shot. The body moves while the tool changes state. The same tool appears in several actions.

scenes.title: 서로 다른 높이의 공격 방향
lines: The rail, market, swamp and container fights are separate intervals. Compare the body’s height with the gun’s direction. Examine tool use together with direction selection.

scenes.title: 객차 안에서 높이가 다른 대상
lines: Here is a different train interval. While traversing the carriage, the player aims at an opponent near the floor and then at one on a crate. Follow the body’s route separately from the target’s height.

scenes.title: 공중에서 갈라지는 두 총
lines: During the jump the two guns point in opposite directions. One movement direction cannot stand in for selecting both targets. This illustrates why movement and target selection need separate design.

scenes.title: 지붕 위 이동과 아래쪽 목표
lines: The gun points downward as the body moves above the roof. Following the body alone can miss the lower target. Check the traversal route and the gun’s direction separately.

scenes.title: 지붕에서 객차 안으로 바뀌는 경로
lines: After a spinning jump the body returns to the roof and descends into the carriage. The guns change targets. Check whether movement and target selection remain connected on a new route.
